contexts: practice management system with a report builder
group guideline reserving HPCIAs for cultured cases
free urine culture budgeted for October and November 2026
reading: HPCIA use sits where a hard-to-tablet cat, a short consultation and an owner's expectation meet a prescribing screen that asks nothing. The retrieved evidence links a prescribing prompt and monthly benchmarking feedback to lower HPCIA use and shows that drug-class indicators can be extracted weekly while indication-specific ones cannot. Culture matters most in cats, where most cultured cases grow nothing. The main risks are substitution towards amoxicillin-clavulanate and owners who cannot give tablets; nurses are part of the mechanism, not bystanders.
